decisions.decision: AI agents writing or modifying ATGV source must read relevant accepted .memory JSON decisions from the actual Git source checkout first. These files are development guidance, not installed extension runtime memory.

Unattended improvement may start only during local 12:00–12:59 while ATGV is idle, with verified GitHub PAT read/write access. Create a versioned change and PR, then automatically squash-merge the PR after all required GitHub checks have passed; never bypass failing, missing, pending or blocked checks.

For every completed ATGV source change, create the next sequential version and a PR. After verified tests, automatically merge eligible PRs into main, allow main-branch release automation to publish VSIX/source artifacts, and report any blocked PR accurately; never claim merge/release before confirmed.

For all 18 SDLC agents and harnesses, use the selected role's trusted expertise and catalog skill. Informational cross-role questions remain answerable from the current role; explicit foreign-role deliverable creation requires a user-approved switch with a working target-role button. Never auto-switch or reassign roles. Follow .memory/role-boundaries.json and verify disabled-role handling and persistent next actions.
